prompt: Cho hình chóp đều S.ABCD. Mệnh đề nào sau đây đúng?
solution: Ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi><mo>⊥</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math> (do <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math> là hình vuông), <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi><mo>⊥</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>O</mi></mrow></semantics></math> (do <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>O</mi><mo>⊥</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>), suy ra <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi><mo>⊥</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>. Do đó, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>⊥</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>.
